verified: Secondary coverage reports that Harvard researchers found AI coding agents shifted the developer bottleneck to code review; the item itself supplies no primary paper, figures or quotations.
unconfirmed: The study's methodology, sample size, models tested, publication venue and peer-review status; whether the shift is measured or inferred; and whether the effect holds outside the settings the researchers examined. Commenters also dispute how current the finding is, with one arguing such research lags practice by months.

verified: ComplexDiscovery 报道称，哈佛研究人员发现 AI 编码代理把开发者瓶颈推向代码审查环节；Hacker News 上出现了大量从业者就此展开的讨论。
unconfirmed: 研究的具体结论强度与适用范围，包括论文标题、作者、发表状态、样本量、所用模型及版本、衡量“瓶颈转移”的指标，以及是否经过独立复现；这些均只见于二手描述，来源未提供可核查细节。
